symptom: The first independently assigned boundary-audit Codex task completed two turns without a visible report, while the data-dependency audit passed and the source snapshot remains unchanged.
objective: Obtain one visible read-only independent audit of the revised Controller boundary, integrate it with the completed data audit, and get a distinct final review without repeating paid or data work.
boundary: Only read-only inspection and dedicated curated logs. No source edits, provider call, public fetch, release, push, admission, budget mutation or Dev/Final access. No silent inference from the empty prior task turn.
resolution_check: An independent final reviewer checks one integrated source-hashed packet, tests, zero-provider canary, data-blocked finding and actual audit outputs; missing report or source mismatch is REPLAN.
